title: Room plan
description: The space where the occasion takes place, to scale. Seating and fit checks start from here.

venue.title: Use the venue's plan
venue.body: Your venue has published approved plans. The plan enters the occasion at its current version; if the venue changes it later, you receive a proposal you accept or not.
venue.notCalibrated: The venue has not calibrated its drawing yet, so it cannot be used for seating.

own.name: Name of the space
own.dimsHint: Leave empty if you do not know it yet.
own.drawHint: Draw the room's exact shape, with walls and corners to scale.
own.drawnNote: The room is drawn; its size comes from the drawing.

empty.title: No room plan yet
empty.body: Describe the space below so you can arrange the tables. If you add the venue from the business list to your suppliers, its approved plans appear here.

newer.title: The venue has published version {n} of the plan, valid from {date}
newer.body: Your plan stays on version {n} until you accept the change. Nothing changes by itself.
newer.notCalibrated: The new version is not calibrated, so it cannot be used in the plan.

facts.title: What we know about the space
facts.ownSource: Entered by you, not by the venue

inventory.title: The venue's tables
inventory.body: What the venue provides. You can also add tables of your own on the seating page.

settings.title: Space settings
settings.aisleHint: Free room between tables with the chairs pulled out. Usually 60 cm.

remove.title: Give up the room plan?
remove.body: The placed tables, the guests' seats and the stage variants are deleted too. Guests no longer see their seat.
remove.confirm: Delete the plan and the seating

errors.noModel: The occasion has no room plan yet. Choose one first.
errors.alreadyHasModel: The occasion already has a room plan. Give it up before choosing another.
errors.notCalibrated: This drawing is not calibrated, so it cannot be used for the plan or for fit checks.
errors.stale: The proposal is out of date: the plan has changed meanwhile. Discard it and ask for a new one.
errors.measure: Type a measure in metres, for example 12 or 8.5.

whatif.updateTitle: The venue has updated the plan “{name}”
whatif.name: Name of the space
whatif.becomesCustom: becomes a table of your own
whatif.overCount: The venue now has only {count} “{name}” tables.
whatif.typeGone: The venue no longer has this table type.
whatif.noLongerFits: no longer fits the usable area
whatif.customNote: A table of your own, not the venue's. Drawn with a dashed line.

guest.title: Room plan
guest.intro: Where to find what you need in the room.
guest.planLabel: Plan of the room {name}, with its points of interest

draw.title: Draw the room
draw.description: Draw the shape of “{name}” to scale: walls, corners and areas. Tables are then placed on this drawing.

unavailable.noSpace: Create the space first, then you can draw it.
unavailable.venue: This space comes from the venue's plan and isn't redrawn here.
unavailable.role: Only the organiser and project managers can draw the room.

snap.title: Snapping: {state}
snap.angleHint: Hold Shift to switch it for one move.

draw.keys: Keys: V select, W walls, R rectangle, D door, P pillar, M measure, Enter closes the outline, Backspace removes the last corner or the selection, arrows move the selection (Shift = 10×), Esc cancels, + and − zoom, F fits.

line.live: Wall of {length} m at {angle}°. Click to fix the corner.
line.start: Click where the first wall starts, or type the start point below.
line.next: Click for the next corner. Click the first corner or press Enter to close the outline.
line.needThree: An outline needs at least three corners.
line.from: Starts from x {x} m, y {y} m.

rect.live: {w} × {l} m. Click to fix the opposite corner.
rect.first: Click the first corner of the rectangle, or type its size below.
rect.flat: A rectangle needs both a width and a length.

select.corner: Corner at x {x} m, y {y} m
select.hint: Click a wall, a corner or an outline. Drag corners to reshape; drag an outline to move it; drag empty space to pan.
select.minCorners: An outline needs at least three corners.
select.wallHint: The far corner moves; the next wall keeps its direction.
select.split: Add a corner in the middle

limits.areas: You can draw at most {max} outlines.
limits.corners: An outline can have at most {max} corners.
limits.doors: You can place at most {max} doors.
limits.pillars: You can place at most {max} pillars.

problems.title: The drawing has a problem
problems.body: Fix the marked outlines before saving.

errors.network: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.measure: Type a length in metres, for example 6.5.
errors.angle: Type an angle in degrees, for example 90.
errors.tooSmall: Area {n} is under half a square metre.
errors.ownOnly: Only a space you described yourself can be drawn.
errors.drawnSize: The room is drawn: change its size in the drawing.

door.offWall: Door {n} no longer fits on its wall: move it or make it narrower.
door.tooWide: Door {n} is wider than its wall.

errors.doorWidth: Type a width between 0.5 and 6 m.
errors.pillarSize: Type a size between 0.1 and 3 m.

draw.itemsNote: Tables already placed show dotted and stay where they are. The fit check shows you if any ended up outside the room.
draw.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

door.tooShort: The wall is shorter than the door.
door.onWall: Click a wall to place the door.
door.hint: Click a wall to place a door. You can then drag it along the wall.
door.typedHint: From the keyboard: select a wall and press “Put a door here”.
door.name: Door {n}
door.offsetHint: From the wall's first corner to the edge of the door.
door.flipHinge: Move the hinges to the other side
door.clearNote: The shaded floor in front of the door stays clear; the fit check tells you if a table is on it.

pillar.live: Pillar at x {x} m, y {y} m. Click to place it.
pillar.hint: Click where the pillar stands, or type its position below.
pillar.name: Pillar {n}

measure.live: {length} m. Click to fix the end.
measure.first: Click the first point to measure from.
measure.title: Measurements
measure.none: No measurements yet. Measurements are not saved.
measure.item: Measurement {n}: {length} m ({dx} m across, {dy} m down)
